description: Capture an image of the running game (target='game', default) or of the editor's 2D/3D viewport (target='editor'). Game captures are scaled to the project's viewport size (normalize='viewport') so repeated screenshots compare like for like; pass normalize='none' to keep the window size. The text says the size and, when it differed, the window size. Not available when running headless.

max_width.description: Downscale to at most this width (default 1280).

normalize.description: Game only: scale to the project's viewport size (default) or keep the window size (editor captures are unchanged).

name: screenshot
title: Screenshot
